scope: Bounded implementation reference inventory before further v2 work; not a full parity audit or evidence that v2 tasks are complete.
hash_semantics: SHA-256 of exact git show REV:path bytes; git_blob is the pinned Git object ID. No working-tree bytes used.

policy.preserve: Behavioral obligation only; no wholesale Python port.
policy.adapt: Preserve useful behavior while changing authority, persistence and remote-worker boundaries.
policy.replace: V1 single-host SQL/workspace/runtime integration must be replaced at v2 boundaries.
policy.omit: Do not port v1 vault layout, daemon dependencies or terminal screen heuristics as universal harness guarantees. No new runtime dependency is authorized by this inventory.
